text:
zoe: PR #3498 (streaming examples + fallback note) is blocked by docs-preview + a runtime question: does fallback to a smaller model reset the tokenization/role handling? reviewer flagged mismatch in example outputs. tagging @rahul and @kevin.

rahul: Link?

zoe: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3498 -- preview failed during runtime metadata fetch (403) and reviewer noticed the JS streaming snippet assumes identical tokenization between rwd-4 and rwd-2-small when we fallback.

ci-bot: docs-preview job #612 failed: runtime metadata access denied (403). Logs: /builds/3498/logs/612.

kevin: Quick runtime clarification: fallback may change model, which can change tokenization and role-system behavior for structured outputs. We don't rewrite prompts; the runtime will replay the request against the fallback model. So docs should warn that fallback can change exact token counts and in rare cases slightly change structured output boundaries. We guarantee semantic-preservation intent but not byte-for-byte identical tokens.

rahul: SDK note: JS streaming default is still "streamingMode: 'chunked'" and we don't attempt post-fallback normalization. Recommend doc text: "Fallback to a different model may alter tokenization and timing; pin model versions for deterministic outputs or handle minor differences in your parsing logic." Also mention how to opt out of fallback via the route config example.

zoe: OK I'll add a short warning and show `route: { fallback: false }` snippet + a short parsing-safety tip. For the preview, I'll replace the live metadata call with a preview stub to avoid the 403.

kevin: Runtime confirms behavior. Approve wording.

ci-bot: retriggered docs-preview #612 (attempt 2).

ci-bot: docs-preview #612 succeeded.

zoe: Requested re-review.

rahul: Approved, lgtm.

zoe: Merged during today's window. Follow-up: add an FAQ entry about fallback tokenization edge cases. :white_check_mark:
